start: An owner signed in on a desk device that was online earlier today; the internet is down

steps.action: Open the panel
user_sees: The panel opens on Today

Bar: 'Offline: nothing waiting to send. No internet. Check-ins, payments and new members are saved on this device and sent when the internet is back. Other things wait. Details shown are from {time}.'
must_not: A sign-in page
A blank page or an endless spinner
No word on how old the details are

steps.action: Search a member and open their page
user_sees: Their plan, its end date and what they owe, as last fetched
must_not: Dues of zero because nothing could be fetched
A member missing who was there when the copy was made

steps.action: Open Plans and the dues list
user_sees: The plans with prices; the people with dues
must_not: An empty list
An error because the server did not answer

steps.action: The internet comes back
user_sees: The bar goes; the details are fresh
must_not: Old details kept on screen after the internet is back

steps.action: Open the panel on a device that never fetched this gym while signed in (first use, or the copy was cleared)
user_sees: A plain message that the internet is needed
must_not: An empty gym that looks real
Another gym’s copy opened

steps.action: Open a page that cannot work from the copy
user_sees: '{name} needs the internet' and 'This page opens when the internet is back. Open Members to save check-ins, payments and new members now.'
must_not: A half-drawn page with empty figures

steps.action: Change a plan price
user_sees: 'No internet, so this can't be saved now. Check-ins, payments and new members still work. Try this again when the internet is back.'
must_not: The change shown as saved in the copy

start: An owner on a desk device that holds a copy of the gym

steps.action: Sign out while online
user_sees: The sign-in page; the copy of the gym is removed from the device
must_not: The members and dues still readable on the device after the sign-out

steps.action: Turn the internet off and open the panel
user_sees: The sign-in page (signing in needs the internet)
must_not: The gym opening from a copy for a signed-out device

steps.action: Sign in again online, open Settings, Sign-in & data, tap 'Clear offline copy', then 'Yes, clear it'
user_sees: 'Clear the offline copy on this device? Nothing is deleted from your gym’s records online.'
'Offline copy cleared. Your gym’s records online are safe. A fresh copy downloads while this device is online.'
must_not: Any record deleted from the gym online
No fresh copy made afterwards, so the next outage shows nothing

start: An owner on a device that two gyms use (one sign-in after another)

steps.action: Sign out of gym one, sign in to gym two, go offline
user_sees: Only gym two’s members and dues
must_not: Any member of gym one
Two copies kept on the device

steps.action: Read what the copy holds
user_sees: The same records the panel shows this person on screen
must_not: The sign-in key itself stored with the copy
The copy readable from a sign-in to another gym
